description: Pinned nearby-galaxy catalogue; Local Group membership is a separate evidence-based classification, never a radius cut.

smc.reason: Direct published eclipsing-binary distance replaces older Cioni2000 modulus in this pinned LVDB release; errors remain separate.

m_101.reason: Published Cepheid distance modulus 29.135 +/- 0.045 (Table 5) replaces the Tully2009 modulus 29.21 in this pinned LVDB release, so M101 sits where its nearby-universe dot does.

selection.eligible: All rows in authored galaxy/candidate/host tables with usable ICRS coordinates, finite sourced distance modulus (or explicit measured override), no confirmed cluster or author false positive. Candidates remain candidates.
selection.unspecifiedMethods: A blank method stays unspecified with the original distance paper reference; no Hubble-law conversion is performed.
selection.membership: 143 exact name bindings into the author October2019 table. Canis Major has no matching release row. G/A/L and mixed G/L,A/L,L/G,L/A preserve published association; N preserves nearby-neighbor classification. New satellite host chains supplement the historical membership table. Unmatched field membership remains uncertain.
selection.halfLightRadius: Projected semi-major angular half-light radius converted using small-angle radians at the adopted distance. Its reported errors transport angular-fit errors only; distance uncertainty is separate. It is neither full diameter nor a spherical galaxy boundary.
selection.precision: Derived parsec distances and metre coordinates rounded to12 significant digits for cross-platform reproducibility; vastly below reported astronomical uncertainties. Source angles and original input bytes are preserved.
selection.epoch: Shared navigation epoch2461286.5; catalogue coordinates are retained ICRS/J2000 directions without proper-motion propagation.
selection.milkyWay: Release MW row has no independent heliocentric distance, so it is excluded from this positional bank. The existing Milky Way renderer retains its scientific registration and is not duplicated.
selection.yamlCompatibility: Original archive contains duplicate keys in some unused fields, including one duplicate display name. Released CSV supplies labels and measurements. Duplicate keys in consumed metadata (positions, aliases, hosts, source references and classification exclusions) are rejected. Original bytes remain unchanged.
